name: OGBG-Code2: Method Abstract Syntax Tree Graph Benchmark
description: OGBG-Code2 is a large-scale graph property prediction benchmark for source code representation learning derived from 13,587 popular open-source Python repositories on GitHub. It contains 452,741 Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) graphs extracted from distinct Python methods, with an average of 125.2 nodes and 124.2 edges per graph. The task is to predict the sub-tokens of each method name (code summarization / semantic method naming) evaluated by F1 score over predicted sub-tokens. The dataset uses a project-based split (Train: 407,976 graphs, Validation: 22,817 graphs, Test: 21,948 graphs) ensuring that methods in test and validation sets come from completely disjoint git projects.
